d: Join the Team at ABYAT - Your Gateway to Retail Excellence!

The Customs Clearance Coordinator is responsible for day-to-day shipment and document follow-up for import and export shipments by sea, air, and land. The role coordinates with internal teams, customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, and government authorities to support timely and compliant customs clearance and accurate shipment reporting.
q: 3-5 years of relevant experience in customs clearance, shipping, import/export, freight forwarding, or logistics operations in Kuwait.
Good knowledge of Kuwait customs clearance procedures and shipping documents for sea, air, and land and cross-border shipments.
Practical experience coordinating with customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, suppliers, and internal teams.
Good knowledge of Excel and shipment tracking/reporting; familiarity with ERP/ SAP.
Arabic and English communication skills are required.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.
Familiarity with Kuwait government portals and approval requirements, including MOH, CITRA, EPA/Ozone, PAI, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities as applicable.
Knowledge of COC, technical inspection certificates, import permits, and related clearance approvals is preferred.
r: Track daily import and export shipments by sea, air, and land until customs release and delivery.
Follow up clearance progress with appointed customs brokers and escalate delays or issues when needed.
Collect, review, and file shipping and customs documents received from supply chain, business units, suppliers, and freight forwarders.
Check document completeness and identify discrepancies before customs submission.
Verify HS code classification and declaration accuracy in coordination with brokers and internal teams.
Prepare and follow up on required approvals, permits, COC, and technical inspection certificates when assigned.
Use relevant Kuwait government portals such as MOH, CITRA, EPA/Ozone, PAI, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities as applicable.
Coordinate with customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, warehouse teams, Supply Chain, and business units.
Provide regular shipment status updates and support resolution of operational requirements.
Prepare shipment tracking reports and daily activity reports accurately and on time.
Handle clearance-related petty cash, supporting documents, and reconciliation in line with company procedures.
Maintain accurate shipment records and support compliant import/export execution.
Report documentation gaps, customs holds, inspection issues, or other risks to the Senior Officer / Team Leader.
Coordinate transportation execution after customs clearance by arranging trucks with approved transporters for both domestic and cross-border shipments.
Follow up on shipment dispatch from port, airport, or bonded facilities to warehouse or final destination.
Monitor shipment movement and ensure on-time delivery according to operational timelines.
Coordinate with warehouse and transportation teams to ensure smooth inbound and outbound shipment handling.
Track transportation status through the system and ensure shipment visibility until final delivery completion.
